finding: Diabetes mellitus in pregnancy, including pregestational diabetes and gestational diabetes, poses serious risks to the fetus, newborn, and mother, necessitating early screening, glycemic control, and appropriate pregnancy management.
mod_finding: Caesarean section is recommended when estimated fetal weight is 4500 g or more, but the mode of delivery should be decided on a case-by-case basis.
birth_weight: 4500 g or more (for caesarean section consideration)
